protocol.procedure: Use public failure evidence to propose one reusable branch-and-dispatch workflow. Respect the DSL grammar.

improver_protocol.procedure: Use public failure evidence to propose one reusable branch-and-dispatch workflow. Respect the DSL grammar.

grammar.steps: 1..3 ordered dispatch operations, optional release_stalled at start, final fallback
grammar.release: object with op=release_stalled only; optional first step
grammar.fallback: final object with op=fallback and policy=ddqn only

semantics.due_soon: age + nearest known travel distance >= .75 * public target deadline
semantics.stalled: some free executor repeats the same positions for two two-step periods
semantics.least_slack: prioritize deadline minus age minus distance
semantics.nearest: rank target first, then nearest free executor
semantics.global_min: greedily choose best distance-minus-priority pair over all free executors and eligible targets
semantics.until_observed: keep assignment until observed by any executor
semantics.release_stalled: release stuck committed executor before dispatch

prompt.acceptance: Prioritize coverage, then heterogeneous-deadline violation, then weighted idleness, then intervention cost. No metric/parameter edits.
rules: Return JSON only. workflow must be an object containing steps, not prose or code.
The listed domains are exact strings, no placeholder names. Preserve final DDQN fallback.
All model weights, VAE refreshes (one sample per step), deadlines and interpreter are fixed.
